description: Fork of exp554 (HARD Kendall K=384, tied, residual->E=64, learnable sign_temp). ONLY change: residual_tph 128->256 (double the residual LUT tables -> richer predicted embedding e_hat). Tests the backbone-capacity lever on the ~+0.25 Kendall plateau (vs the resolution lever K2016, which gave a growing ~-0.02). residual_lut weight 256*64*64/layer. vs exp554/exp551 (res_tph=128, ~1.94@1600), exp513 Linear 1.4825/1.4656.
